verdicts.opus: A and D are the only grounded deliverables and score nearly level. D covers more facets, but it miscounts the orientation labels and mislabels the framing windows. A is cleaner but answers weakly. B gives the most domain-useful account of the lecanemab/donanemab shift, but it is from memory and cannot be reproduced.
